nomination.name: StarFoot 1.0.10: iPad, new icon and star life
nomination.description: StarFoot is a football (soccer) career game made by a solo indie developer: you start in a street match, get spotted by scouts and rise from the academy to the world's biggest clubs, playing the key moments of every match yourself (shots, passes, dribbles, free kicks and penalties). Version 1.0.10 brings native iPad support with a wide three-column layout, a brand-new app icon and the "Live Like a Star" features: an encyclopedia page for your career, a chapter-by-chapter career documentary, a luxury showcase and a look studio. The World Championship Dream mode now offers a four-tournament international career (2026 to 2038) with opponent scouting, tactics, a sticker album and an awards night. The game is fully localized in 10 languages, all club and player names are fictional, and two in-app events accompany the update.
nomination.notes: Solo indie developer from Türkiye. Happy to provide additional assets or a TestFlight build.
